title: Leaking kitchen tap
description: The mixer tap under my kitchen sink drips constantly and the washer seems worn. Need it fixed today.

title: Blocked bathroom drain
description: Water will not drain from the shower and there is a bad smell. Likely a blockage in the pipe.

title: Replace faulty sockets
description: Two wall sockets in the living room have stopped working and one sparks. Need a certified electrician.

title: Install ceiling lights
description: We renovated the hallway and need three new LED ceiling lights wired and installed.

title: Fix a sticking door
description: The bedroom door has dropped and no longer closes properly. Hinges may need adjusting or replacing.

title: Build custom bookshelf
description: Looking for a carpenter to build and fit a floor-to-ceiling bookshelf in the study.

title: Repaint living room
description: Two coats of emulsion on the living room walls and ceiling; walls need light filling first.

title: Exterior wall painting
description: The front of the house needs weatherproof exterior paint after some cracks were filled.

title: Re-tile bathroom floor
description: Remove old tiles and lay new ceramic tiles on the bathroom floor, about 6 square metres.

title: Plaster a damaged wall
description: A section of internal wall plaster has come away and needs re-plastering and smoothing.

title: Deep clean before guests
description: Whole-apartment deep clean including kitchen, two bathrooms and floors before family visit.

title: End of tenancy clean
description: Moving out next week and need a full move-out clean to get the deposit back.

title: Odd jobs around the house
description: A few small jobs: rehang a door, fix a loose towel rail and patch a small hole in the wall.

title: Hang pictures and mirror
description: Need several framed pictures and a heavy mirror hung securely on plaster walls.

title: Assemble flat-pack wardrobe
description: Just delivered a large flat-pack wardrobe and two bedside tables that need assembling.

title: Office desk assembly
description: Two flat-pack office desks and a chair to be assembled in a home office.

title: Mount 55 inch TV
description: Wall-mount a 55-inch TV on a brick wall and tidy the cables. Bracket already bought.

title: Put up curtain rails
description: Install curtain poles and a couple of floating shelves in the bedroom.

title: Washing machine not spinning
description: My washing machine fills but will not spin or drain. Needs diagnosis and repair.

title: Install new oven
description: Bought a new built-in electric oven and need it installed and connected safely.

title: Service two AC units
description: Annual service and gas top-up for two split air-conditioning units in the flat.

title: New AC installation
description: Supply and install a new split A/C unit in the master bedroom; wall already marked.

title: Overgrown garden tidy-up
description: Lawn mowing, weeding the borders and trimming an overgrown hedge in a small back garden.

title: Trim large tree
description: A large tree at the back needs its branches cut back away from the roof.

title: Help moving flat
description: Two people to help load and move furniture from a one-bed flat to a nearby house.

title: Junk removal
description: Clear out and dispose of an old sofa, a broken fridge and general junk from the garage.

title: Fix leaking roof
description: There is a leak in the roof above the bedroom during heavy rain; a few tiles look cracked.

title: Clean gutters
description: Gutters are blocked with leaves and overflowing, need clearing and checking.

title: Cockroach infestation
description: Recurring cockroaches in the kitchen despite sprays, need professional pest control.

title: Termite treatment
description: Signs of termites in a wooden door frame, need inspection and treatment.

title: Repair metal gate
description: The hinge on my steel driveway gate has snapped and needs welding back.

title: වතුර කරාමය කාන්දු වෙනවා
description: මගේ මුළුතැන්ගෙයි කරාමයෙන් වතුර නිතරම කාන්දු වෙනවා. එය හදන්න ඕන.

title: විදුලි ප්ලග් එක වැඩ නැහැ

title: කාමරය තීන්ත ගානවා
description: නිදන කාමරයේ බිත්ති දෙපැත්තම අලුතින් තීන්ත ගාන්න ඕන.

title: ගෙදර ගැඹුරු පිරිසිදු කිරීම
description: අමුත්තන් එන නිසා මුළු නිවසම හොඳින් පිරිසිදු කරන්න ඕන.

title: ඒසී එක සර්විස් කරන්න
description: නිදන කාමරයේ ඒසී එක සර්විස් කර ගෑස් දාන්න ඕන.

title: වත්ත පිරිසිදු කිරීම
description: පිටිපස්සේ වත්තේ තණකොළ කපලා වැට කප්පාදු කරන්න ඕන.

title: නාන කාමරයට ටයිල් දාන්න
description: නාන කාමරයේ බිම පරණ ටයිල් අයින් කර අලුත් ටයිල් දාන්න ඕන.

title: වහලය කාන්දු වෙනවා

title: රෙදි සෝදන යන්ත්‍රය අළුත්වැඩියාව
description: රෙදි සෝදන මැෂිම කැරකෙන්නේ නෑ, හදන්න ඕන.

title: ටීවී එක බිත්තියේ සවි කරන්න

title: கதவு சரிசெய்ய வேண்டும்
description: படுக்கையறை கதவு சரியாக மூடவில்லை, கீல்களை சரிசெய்ய தச்சர் தேவை.

title: வீட்டு சிறு பழுதுகள்
description: சில சிறிய வேலைகள்: கதவை சரிசெய்ய, தளர்வான டவல் ரெயிலை இறுக்க வேண்டும்.

title: அலமாரி பொருத்துதல்
description: புதிதாக வந்த பிரிக்கக்கூடிய அலமாரி மற்றும் இரண்டு மேசைகளை பொருத்த வேண்டும்.

title: வீடு மாற்ற உதவி
description: ஒரு அறை வீட்டிலிருந்து அருகில் உள்ள வீட்டிற்கு பொருட்களை மாற்ற இருவர் தேவை.

title: கரப்பான் பூச்சி தொல்லை
description: சமையலறையில் கரப்பான் பூச்சிகள் அதிகம், தொழில்முறை பூச்சி கட்டுப்பாடு தேவை.

title: இரும்பு கேட் பழுது
description: எஃகு கேட்டின் கீல் உடைந்துவிட்டது, வெல்டிங் செய்ய வேண்டும்.

title: விளக்குகள் பொருத்துதல்
description: மண்டபத்தில் மூன்று புதிய எல்ஐடி விளக்குகளை பொருத்த வேண்டும்.

title: வீடு காலி சுத்தம்
description: அடுத்த வாரம் வீட்டை காலி செய்கிறேன், முழு சுத்தம் தேவை.

title: Mount shelves and fix a wobble
description: Put up three shelves and while here fix a wobbly cupboard door - could be a handyman or a mounting specialist.

title: Kitchen refresh
description: Repaint the kitchen and reseal around the sink - bit of painting, bit of plumbing.

title: New bathroom bits
description: Install a new toilet and tile the wall behind it.

title: ගෙදර පොදු වැඩ
description: පින්තූර එල්ලන්න සහ ලාච්චුවක් හදන්න ඕන - හෑන්ඩිමෑන් කෙනෙක් හරි.
